policy_candidates.naming: DESIGN §6; allocate_tables/allocate_columns; preserve source identity and original ordinal
policy_candidates.nullability: target_nullable = not bool(source pragma_notnull); do not infer from primary key or absence of observed NULL
policy_candidates.source_constraints: retain declarations as audit metadata; no primary/unique/foreign key/index/default/check execution
policy_candidates.null_values: SQL NULL distinct from empty text; no substitution or filtering

verification.method: existing API allocation plus assertions joining object identity, column ordinal/name, counts and source-notnull/observed-NULL; metadata only, not G2/G4 verification
